title: Sir Keith Park Station

terrainReference.basis: Unmodified elevation sampled beside the rail-facing shelter threshold.

mapIdentity.scope: The mapped shelter enclosure is 4.97 m wide by 3.47 m deep. The door faces the mapped platform and railway. The extent of the immediate apron is estimated.

note: The public-domain Qualla original shows pale pink weatherboard siding, a dark open doorway, a brown flat-looking fascia, an off-white station board and a pale green bench. Dimensions of the roof, bench and openings are inferred from the photo and plan.
